# Version 4.154.0
> **Skia and HarfBuzz alignment** · Released October 12, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.154.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.154.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.154.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.400/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.154.0 aligns HarfBuzz bindings with the bundled engine and improves GPU failure handling. The Skia m154 release also packages source-authored API XML beside managed assemblies. Review the HarfBuzz enum migrations and the removal of RAW/DNG decoding before upgrading.

## Breaking Changes

- **Rename UnicodeCombiningClass.CCC133 to CCC132** — HarfBuzzSharp follows the corrected upstream enum name without retaining an alias. Replace UnicodeCombiningClass.CCC133 with UnicodeCombiningClass.CCC132; its numeric value remains 132. ([#5057](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5057))
- **Replace GlyphFlags.Defined with concrete flags** — HarfBuzzSharp no longer exposes GlyphFlags.Defined, an aggregate mask rather than an independent option. Combine the concrete glyph flags your code requires. The corresponding BufferFlags.Defined and SerializeFlag.Defined aggregate masks are not exposed either. ([#5057](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5057))
- **Use an external decoder for RAW and DNG images** — Built-in RAW/DNG decoding and PIEX extraction of embedded JPEG previews are disabled; no replacement reader is included. Decode these files externally before passing pixels to SkiaSharp. SKEncodedImageFormat.Dng remains for compatibility, but does not indicate codec support. Standalone JPEG decoding is unchanged. ([#5190](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5190))

## Engine

- **Skia milestone m154** — Updates the bundled renderer to m154, including upstream SVG color-filter improvements and Ganesh clipping fixes. The milestone sync preserves existing C exports; native HarfBuzz remains 14.2.1 despite its .400 package revision. ([#4945](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4945))

## API Surface

- **Supported HarfBuzz enum values track the native source** — Synchronizes supported buffer, cluster, glyph, and baseline-tag enum values with HarfBuzz 14.2.1. No new managed types or callback-heavy API families are introduced. ([#5057](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5057))
- **API documentation travels with reference assemblies** — Packages include matching compiler-generated XML beside implementation and reference assemblies, so source-authored API documentation reaches package consumers without changing which obsolete members are compile-visible. ([#5064](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5064), [#5066](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5066))

## Bug Fixes

- **GPU atlas tracking and failure propagation** — Corrects partial glyph-atlas generation tracking and propagates Ganesh prerequisite failures instead of continuing image creation or handle extraction. Unsupported asynchronous reads complete with a null result; existing managed flush signatures stay void. ([#5054](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5054))
- **Failed GPU uploads no longer feed stale draws** — Ganesh checks failed buffer uploads and initialization under memory pressure instead of drawing stale contents. Triangulated paths retain CPU vertex data for a later upload attempt. ([#5114](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5114))
- **Failed flushes discard unusable cached textures** — Ganesh drops uniquely held thread-safe cache entries after a failed flush, preventing later draws from reusing entries for textures that were never initialized. Entries still held elsewhere are not removed. ([#5253](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5253))
- **Uno WebAssembly uses matching HarfBuzz assets** — The Uno views package depends on the matching HarfBuzzSharp WebAssembly native-assets package, avoiding missing-symbol links against an older implicit archive. ([#5057](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5057))
- **Windows HarfBuzz binaries pass BA2007** — Corrects the compiler-warning configuration that caused BinSkim BA2007 failures in applications consuming HarfBuzzSharp.NativeAssets.Win32. Native exports and shaping behavior are unchanged; other existing BinSkim warnings are unaffected. — ❤️ [@azchohfi](https://github.com/azchohfi) ([#5111](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5111))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.400

Bindings now follow the bundled HarfBuzz 14.2.1 source, including supported enum additions, the CCC132 rename, and removal of GlyphFlags.Defined. Packages carry source-authored API XML, and Windows native assets correct BinSkim BA2007 failures; no native engine upgrade is implied by revision .400.
